root.exact_statement:
Establish a checked finite-history classification of the charged product-attention recovery mechanism D1-D8, connecting a real low-alphabet-dimension statistical interface to probability convergence, complete resource costs and located-error reliability. The required conjunction is C1-C4; the seed identity or an operator-rank lemma alone is not completion.
C1 (realization and T1). Prove or correct the finite-path two-product-head and boundary-flow construction from actual local causal binding, Q/K/V and the four statistical heads in D3. Construct a theta-independent legal simplex predictor family for every fixed D1 source, including zero counts, explicitly charged smoothing/readout, and a single theta-independent accuracy schedule yielding max_s TV(Pi_N(s),p_theta(.|s))->0 almost surely, with valid actual terminal consequences. Establish O(K) alphabetic value/QK dimensions for the statistical interface without a free joint table. Report separately the actual full neural width, depth, precision and parameter costs; if a proposed primitive or linear-dimension claim fails, give its precise obstruction and a charged replacement, without silently preserving a false resource claim.
C2 (T2 and strong comparison). Derive explicit finite-history joint-statistic and finite-implementation error bounds and full resource functions on the same realized family. Show how alphabet size, history length, target accuracy, fixed score parameters, context frequency and stated dependence bounds enter. Prove the narrowly scoped exact-kernel rank comparison in D7 or a corrected precise statement, and separately compare the realized predictor against strong legal same-budget baselines. State tradeoffs, equality or dominance by a baseline honestly. An operator rank, a deliberately slow inverse, a free full table or a large common cap alone is not a resource-efficiency conclusion.
C3 (T3). In a fully declared complete visible representation and located error model for this same mechanism, prove a nonempty robustness region and a concrete failure/obstruction region or a rigorous counterconstruction to the proposed failure mechanism. Track normalizer recovery, two-head differencing, endpoint corrections and final conditioning separately, including all auxiliary errors and correlations. Supply at least one substantive finite-N stochastic reliability or computational-separation result with a compatible achievable bound; do not substitute population aliasing, empirical-function collision or generic output quantization for the stated prediction risk. Any weaker scoped result is intermediate and must not silently discharge this clause.
C4 (integration and scientific decision). Deliver one fixed-version complete theorem/proof/counterexample package joining C1-C3, exact assumptions and quantifiers, full error/resource ledgers, real failed routes, independent fixed-version review and native admissions. Compare the strongest obtained mechanism claim with pinned primary literature, including the prior itemwise operator and difference/inclusion-exclusion/count-recovery constructions, at the level of actual information, architecture, resources and risk. Known algebra is a starting point. If the promised advantage disappears under a legal baseline, retain that negative classification; do not invent novelty. Explain in ordinary Chinese what is learned and which mother-problem questions remain.

Incompatible changes to this exact contract require a linked new native contract and preserved failure evidence.
